content.short: Tulipa Capital is a DeFi asset manager curating on-chain vaults, active since 2019.
content.description: Tulipa Capital deploys capital at scale on-chain and positions itself as an advisory partner rather than an execution desk. The firm emphasises honest feedback and judgment in the mandates it takes, including asking clients the questions they have not considered. Its activity extends to Monad.
content.meta: A curator active since 2019, whose value lies in what it declines to accept as collateral.
